Health Functional FoodMagnesium 250mgZinc 16mgCalcium 250mg2 times a day

솔리드씨엠(구)Magnesium · Zinc · Calcium

Made by 주식회사 네추럴웨이 · 2 times a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 250mg of Magnesium, 16mg of Zinc, 250mg of Calcium as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 tablets): 250mg Magnesium, 16mg Zinc, 250mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 네추럴웨이

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 tablets per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Magnesium labelled (250mg / 4800mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (16mg / 4800mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (250mg / 4800mg), 80~150%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없는 미백색 타원형의 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 실온

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Magnesium · Zinc · Calcium together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

source.mainFunction:

source.baseStandard:
1) 성상 : 고유의 색택과 향미를 가지고 이미, 이취가 없어야 한다.
2) 감마리놀렌산 : 표시량(240mg/2700mg)의 80~120%
3) 비타민E : 표시량(3.3mg/2700mg)의 80~150%
4) 대장균군 : 음성
5) 붕해시험 : 20분 이내
source.intake:
1일 3회, 1회 2캡슐을 충분한 물과 함께 섭취하십시오. 
1일 2회, 1회 3캡슐을 충분한 물과 함께 섭취하십시오.
source.caution:
섭취 시 목에 걸리거나 불편할 수 있으므로 반드시 물과 함께 섭취하십시오. 
섭취 시 위장장애, 소화불량의 증상이 있을 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오. 
개인의 신체 상태에 따라 이상 증상이 생길 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오. 
섭취 전 제품에 이상이 있는 경우 섭취를 금하십시오.
특정 원료 성분에 알레르기 체질은 원료 성분을 확인 후 섭취하십시오.
source.dosageForm: 검정색의 내용물을 함유한 투명색의 연질캡슐.
source.storage:
수분, 열에 의해 품질에 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.
어린이 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

source.baseStandard:

산사의 이슬감마리놀렌산 · 비타민 E

(주)유니쎌팜 제조 · 1일 2회 2캡슐

이 제품은 감마리놀렌산 240mg, 비타민 E 17mg를 표시량으로 담은 2원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 2회(2캡슐) 섭취로 감마리놀렌산 240mg, 비타민 E 17mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 갈색 내용물을 함유한 검은 갈색 타원형 연질캡슐 · (주)유니쎌팜 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • 감마리놀렌산
    • 혈중 콜레스테롤 개선·혈행개선·면역과민반응에 의한 피부상태 개선·월경전 변화에 의한 불편한 상태 개선에 도움을 줄 수 있음
  • 비타민 E
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 2회1회 2캡슐물과 함께

표시 기준

감마리놀렌산 표시량(240mg/2g)의 80~120%
비타민 E 표시량(17mg/2g)의 80~150%
성상 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 갈색 내용물을 함유한 검은 갈색 타원형 연질캡슐
대장균군 음성
유통기한 제조일로부터 24개월
보관 고온 다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 실온에 보관하십시오.

이런 분께

  • 매일 감마리놀렌산 · 비타민 E 섭취를 함께 챙기고 싶은 분
  • 연질캡슐 형태를 선호하는 분

Health Functional FoodGamma-linolenic acid 240mgVitamin E 17mg2 times a day

산사의 이슬Gamma-linolenic acid · Vitamin E

Made by (주)유니쎌팜 · 2 times a day · 2 capsules

This product combines 240mg of Gamma-linolenic acid, 17mg of Vitamin E as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 capsules): 240mg Gamma-linolenic acid, 17mg Vitamin E
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)유니쎌팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Gamma-linolenic acid
    • May help with improving blood cholesterol, improving blood circulation, improving skin condition related to immune hypersensitivity, and easing discomfort related to premenstrual changes
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 capsules per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Gamma-linolenic acid labelled (240mg / 2g), 80~120%
Vitamin E labelled (17mg / 2g), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 갈색 내용물을 함유한 검은 갈색 타원형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 고온 다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 실온에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Gamma-linolenic acid · Vitamin E together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

source.caution:
- 특이체질, 알레르기 체질의 경우 성분을 확인하시고 섭취하십시오.
- 소비기한을 확인하시기 바라며, 섭취량 및 섭취방법을 준수하십시오.
- 제품 개봉 또는 섭취 시 포장재에 의해 상처를 입을 수 있으니 주의하십시오.
- 어린이 섭취 시 보호자의 지도, 감독 하에 섭취시키십시오.
- 용기 안의 방습제(실리카겔)는 절대 섭취하지 마십시오.

1) 비타민A : 어두운 곳에서 시각 적응을 위해 필요, 피부와 점막을 형성하고 기능을 유지하는데 필요, 상피세포의 성장과 발달에 필요.

    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone

  • Vitamin E

  • Vitamin K

    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Selenium

  • Folate

Once a day1 capsule per servingWith water

Vitamin B6 labelled (40mg / 450mg), 80~150%

source.mainFunction:
1) 비타민B6 : 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요, 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요.
2) 비타민C : 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요, 철의 흡수에 필요, 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
source.baseStandard:
1) 성상 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 분홍빛 하얀색의 분말을 함유한 보라색, 백색불투명의 경질캡슐
2) 비타민B6 : 표시량(30mg/1200mg) 80~150%
3) 비타민C : 표시량(30mg/1200mg) 80~150%
4) 대장균군 : 음성 
5) 붕해시험 : 20분 이내
source.intake: 1일 1회, 1회 4캡슐을 충분한 물과 함께 섭취하십시오. 1일 2회, 1회 2캡슐을 충분한 물과 함께 섭취하십시오.
source.caution:
섭취 시 목에 걸리거나 불편할 수 있으므로 반드시 물과 함께 섭취하십시오. 
섭취 시 위장장애, 소화불량의 증상이 있을 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오.
개인의 신체 상태에 따라 이상 증상이 생길 경우 섭취를 중단하십시오.
섭취 전 제품에 이상이 있는 경우 섭취를 금하십시오.
특정 원료 성분에 알레르기 체질은 원료 성분을 확인 후 섭취하십시오.
손발 따끔거림, 작열감 또는 저림 등의 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담하십시오. 
과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의하십시오.
신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담하십시오.
이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담하십시오.

1. 그대로 삼킬 경우 목에 걸릴 우려가 있으니 반드시 씹거나 녹여서 드십시오.(특히 영유아[만3세(36개월)미만]의 섭취의 경우에는 보호자의 지도, 감독하에 섭취시키십시오.)또한 과량 섭취시 설사를 유발할 수도 있습니다.

10. 신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담하십시오.

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 0.5mg Copper, 200mg Magnesium, 5mg Zinc, 400mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)서흥헬스케어

  • Copper
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingChew to take

Copper labelled (0.5mg / 25g), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (200mg / 25g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (5mg / 25g), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (400mg / 25g), 80~150%

Coliform Negative

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Copper · Magnesium · Zinc · Calcium together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients

This product combines 4mg of Vitamin B2, 9mg of Vitamin B6, 3000mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 4mg Vitamin B2, 9mg Vitamin B6, 3000mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)케이에이치앤비

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin B2 labelled (4mg / 4500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (9mg / 4500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (3000mg / 4500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 4500mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 연한 노랑색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 습기가 적고 직사광선을 받지 않는 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

비타민 C 표시량(100mg/1000mg)의 80~150%
아연 표시량(3.6mg/1000mg)의 80~150%

대장균군 음성

drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodVitamin B2 0.48mgVitamin C 100mgZinc 3.6mgOnce a day

키즈비타민Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Zinc

Made by (주)유유헬스케어 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 0.48mg of Vitamin B2, 100mg of Vitamin C, 3.6mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 0.48mg Vitamin B2, 100mg Vitamin C, 3.6mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)유유헬스케어

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingLet it dissolve

Labelled standard

Vitamin B2 labelled (0.48mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (3.6mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유의 향미를 가진 노란색의 원형정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage ① 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 병포장의 경우 제품 개봉 후 보관시 흡습방지를 위해 뚜껑을 꼭 닫아야 함.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

닥터피엔티 마이어스Niacin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주) · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 45mg of Niacin, 10mg of Vitamin B1, 15μg of Vitamin B12, 2.5mg of Vitamin B2, 5mg of Vitamin B6, 300mg of Vitamin C, 150μg of Selenium, 10mg of Zinc, 1700μg of Folate, 13mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 45mg Niacin, 10mg Vitamin B1, 15μg Vitamin B12, 2.5mg Vitamin B2, 5mg Vitamin B6, 300mg Vitamin C, 150μg Selenium, 10mg Zinc, 1700μg Folate, 13mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (45mg / 11000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (10mg / 11000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (15μg / 11000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (2.5mg / 11000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (5mg / 11000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (300mg / 11000mg), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (150μg / 11000mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (10mg / 11000mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (1700μg / 11000mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (13mg / 11000mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미,이취가 없는 주황색 입자를 포함한 백색 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1. 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하시고, 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.2. 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습이 일어날 수 있으니 반드시 밀봉하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • Selenium

  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

데일리비타 발포멀티비타민 오렌지맛Niacin · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate

Made by 맥널티바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 sachet

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 3mg of Manganese, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 200mg of Vitamin C, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 sachet): 15mg Niacin, 3mg Manganese, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 200mg Vitamin C, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc, 400μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 맥널티바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 sachet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 5g), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (3mg / 5g), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (30μg / 5g), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 5g), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 5g), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 5g), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 5g), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (200mg / 5g), 80~150%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 5g), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 5g), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 5g), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 노란하얀색의 분말
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 실온보관 / 직사광선을 피하고 서늘하고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Selenium · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

[비타민 D] 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요, 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요, 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
[아연] 정상적인 면역기능에 필요, 정상적인 세포분열에 필요
source.baseStandard:
1. 성상 : 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 노란 하양의 점도가 있는 내용물을 함유한 주황의 타원형 츄어블 연질캡슐
2. 비타민K : 표시량(100ug/300mg)의 80~180%
3. 비타민D : 표시량(50ug/300mg)의 80~180%
4. 아연 : 표시량(8.5mg/300mg)의 80~150%
5. 대장균군 : 음성
source.caution:
특정질환, 특이체질, 알레르기체질, 임산부의 경우에는 간혹 개인에 따라 과민반응이 나타날 수 있으므로 원료를 확인하시고, 섭취전에 전문가와 상담하시기 바랍니다.
제품 개봉 또는 섭취 시 포장재에 의해 다칠 우려가 있으니 주의하시기 바랍니다.
이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
[비타민 K] 항응고제 등 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
[비타민 D] 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
source.dosageForm: 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 노란 하양의 점도가 있는 내용물을 함유한 주황의 타원형 츄어블 연질캡슐
source.storage: 1. 고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오. 3. 영유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. 4. 온도 및 습도 등의 변화에 의해 캡슐이 붙는 현상이 발생될 수 있으나, 품질에 이상이 없으니 안심하고 섭취하십시오.

비타민 D3K2비타민 D · 비타민 K · 아연

주식회사 노바렉스2공장 제조 · 1일 1회 1캡슐

이 제품은 비타민 D 50μg, 비타민 K 100μg, 아연 8.5mg를 표시량으로 담은 3원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1캡슐) 섭취로 비타민 D 50μg, 비타민 K 100μg, 아연 8.5mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 노란 하양의 점도가 있는 내용물을 함유한 주황의 타원형 츄어블 연질캡슐 · 주식회사 노바렉스2공장 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
    • 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
  • 비타민 K
    • 정상적인 혈액응고에 필요
    • 뼈의 구성에 필요
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 1회1회 1캡슐씹어 섭취

표시 기준

비타민 D 표시량(50μg/300mg)의 80~180%
비타민 K 표시량(100μg/300mg)의 80~180%
아연 표시량(8.5mg/300mg)의 80~150%
성상 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 노란 하양의 점도가 있는 내용물을 함유한 주황의 타원형 츄어블 연질캡슐
대장균군 음성
유통기한 제조일로부터 24개월
보관 1. 고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오. 3. 영유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. 4.

이런 분께

  • 매일 비타민 D · 비타민 K · 아연 섭취를 함께 챙기고 싶은 분
  • 연질캡슐 형태를 선호하는 분
  • 간편하게 여러 영양을 함께 관리하고 싶은 분
섭취 시 주의사항 · 임산부·수유부는 섭취 전 전문가와 상담 · 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담 · 알레르기 체질 등은 개인에 따라 과민반응 가능 · 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담 · 자세한 주의사항은 제품 표시사항을 확인하십시오

Health Functional FoodVitamin D 50μgVitamin K 100μgZinc 8.5mgOnce a day

비타민 D3K2Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Zinc

Made by 주식회사 노바렉스2공장 · Once a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 50μg of Vitamin D, 100μg of Vitamin K, 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 capsule): 50μg Vitamin D, 100μg Vitamin K, 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 노바렉스2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Vitamin D labelled (50μg / 300mg), 80~180%
Vitamin K labelled (100μg / 300mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 300mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 노란 하양의 점도가 있는 내용물을 함유한 주황의 타원형 츄어블 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1. 고온다습한 곳과 직사광선을 피하여 습기가 적고 건조한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오. 3. 영유아 및 어린이의 손에 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. 4.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin D · Vitamin K · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Made by 한국바이오팜(주)에이치피 · 2 times a day · 2 capsules

This product combines 0.6mg of Copper, 60mg of Niacin, 2mg of Manganese, 25mg of Vitamin B1, 6μg of Vitamin B12, 25mg of Vitamin B2, 20mg of Vitamin B6, 150mg of Vitamin C, 25μg of Vitamin D, 150mg of Vitamin E, 23μg of Selenium, 8mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 capsules): 0.6mg Copper, 60mg Niacin, 2mg Manganese, 25mg Vitamin B1, 6μg Vitamin B12, 25mg Vitamin B2, 20mg Vitamin B6, 150mg Vitamin C, 25μg Vitamin D, 150mg Vitamin E, 23μg Selenium, 8mg Zinc, 400μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 한국바이오팜(주)에이치피

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 capsules per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Coliform Negative

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Copper · Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Selenium · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 0.64mg of Copper, 95mg of Magnesium, 12mg of Vitamin B6, 10μg of Vitamin D, 7.65mg of Zinc, 700mg of Calcium as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 3 times a day (1 tablet): 0.64mg Copper, 95mg Magnesium, 12mg Vitamin B6, 10μg Vitamin D, 7.65mg Zinc, 700mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin D
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Calcium
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

3 times a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Copper labelled (0.64mg / 3600mg), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (95mg / 3600mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B6 labelled (12mg / 3600mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 3600mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (7.65mg / 3600mg), 80~150%
Calcium labelled (700mg / 3600mg), 80~150%

Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1. 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하시고, 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. 2. 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습이 일어날 수 있으니 반드시 밀봉하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Copper · Magnesium · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin D · Zinc · Calcium together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have a condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Made by 에프엔바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 150μg of Biotin, 700μg of Vitamin A, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 8.5mg of Zinc, 680μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 150μg Biotin, 700μg Vitamin A, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 8.5mg Zinc, 680μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 에프엔바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients

source.mainFunction:
1) 비타민A : 어두운 곳에서 시각 적응을 위해 필요, 피부와 점막을 형성하고 기능을 유지하는데 필요, 상피세포의 성장과 발달에 필요.
2) 비타민B1 : 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요.

7) 비타민D : 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요, 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요, 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌. 
8) 비타민E : 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요.
9) 비타민K : 정상적인 혈액응고에 필요, 뼈의 구성에 필요. 
10) 나이아신 : 체내 에너지 생성에 필요.　
11) 판토텐산 : 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요. 
12) 엽산 : 세포와 혈액생성에 필요, 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요, 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요.

14) 아연 : 정상적인 면역기능에 필요, 정상적인 세포분열에 필요.

(주)유유헬스케어 제조 · 1일 1회 1정

이 제품은 비타민 C 550mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 엽산 400μg를 표시량으로 담은 3원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

  • 비타민 C
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요

  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
    • 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
  • 엽산
    • 세포와 혈액생성에 필요
    • 태아 신경관의 정상 발달에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요

1일 1회1회 1정물과 함께

비타민 C 표시량(550mg/1000mg)의 80~150%
비타민 D 표시량(10μg/1000mg)의 80~180%
엽산 표시량(400μg/1000mg)의 80~150%

리포좀비타민C 트리플프리미엄Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Folate

Made by (주)유유헬스케어 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 550mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 400μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 550mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 400μg Folate
  • Made by (주)유유헬스케어

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin C labelled (550mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Folate labelled (400μg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 노란 하양색의 타원형 코팅정제
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선 및 고온다습한 곳을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

임팩타임 정Niacin · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 주식회사 노바렉스 · Once a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 800μg of Biotin, 100mg of Vitamin B1, 400μg of Vitamin B12, 40mg of Vitamin B2, 67mg of Vitamin B6, 30mg of Vitamin C, 9mg of Vitamin E, 15mg of Zinc, 400μg of Folate, 100mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 50mg Niacin, 800μg Biotin, 100mg Vitamin B1, 400μg Vitamin B12, 40mg Vitamin B2, 67mg Vitamin B6, 30mg Vitamin C, 9mg Vitamin E, 15mg Zinc, 400μg Folate, 100mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 노바렉스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 tablets per servingWith water

Biotin labelled (800μg / 1600mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (100mg / 1600mg), 80~180%

Made by (주)한풍네이처팜 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 4.8μg of Vitamin B12, 3mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 8.5mg of Zinc, 800μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 4.8μg Vitamin B12, 3mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 8.5mg Zinc, 800μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)한풍네이처팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin B12 labelled (4.8μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (3mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (100mg / 500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 500mg), 80~150%

Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 고온다습(30℃이상, 상대습도 75%이상) · 직사광선을 피하여 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 2회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 15mg, 비오틴 150μg, 비타민 A 264μg, 비타민 B1 6mg, 비타민 B12 12μg, 비타민 B2 7mg, 비타민 B6 7.5mg, 비타민 C 1000mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 엽산 680μg

  • 비타민 A

  • 비타민 B1

  • 비타민 B12

  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요

  • 엽산

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 150μg of Biotin, 264μg of Vitamin A, 6mg of Vitamin B1, 12μg of Vitamin B12, 7mg of Vitamin B2, 7.5mg of Vitamin B6, 1000mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 680μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 tablet): 15mg Niacin, 150μg Biotin, 264μg Vitamin A, 6mg Vitamin B1, 12μg Vitamin B12, 7mg Vitamin B2, 7.5mg Vitamin B6, 1000mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 680μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)비오팜

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells

    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue

  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels

우리바이오(주) 제조 · 1일 2회 2캡슐

이 제품은 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 B6 1.5mg, 비타민 C 300mg, 비타민 D 12μg, 셀레늄 55μg, 아연 8.5mg를 표시량으로 담은 7원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 2회(2캡슐) 섭취로 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 B6 1.5mg, 비타민 C 300mg, 비타민 D 12μg, 셀레늄 55μg, 아연 8.5mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 회황색의 분말을 포함한 흐린 빨강색의 경질캡슐 · 우리바이오(주) 제조

  • 비타민 B1
    • 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B2
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 B6
    • 단백질 및 아미노산 이용에 필요
    • 혈액의 호모시스테인 수준을 정상으로 유지하는데 필요
  • 비타민 C
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
    • 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
  • 셀레늄
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 2회1회 2캡슐물과 함께

Health Functional FoodVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 1.5mgVitamin C 300mgVitamin D 12μgSelenium 55μgZinc 8.5mg2 times a day

기운찬 이뮨-MKVitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc

Made by 우리바이오(주) · 2 times a day · 2 capsules

This product combines 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 300mg of Vitamin C, 12μg of Vitamin D, 55μg of Selenium, 8.5mg of Zinc as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 capsules): 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 300mg Vitamin C, 12μg Vitamin D, 55μg Selenium, 8.5mg Zinc
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 우리바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day2 capsules per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 1600mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 1600mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (1.5mg / 1600mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (300mg / 1600mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (12μg / 1600mg), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (55μg / 1600mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 1600mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 회황색의 분말을 포함한 흐린 빨강색의 경질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 실온 및 실온유통

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Selenium · Zinc together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

서퍼데이, 판토비나이아신 · 비타민 A · 비타민 B1 · 비타민 B2 · 비타민 C · 비타민 D · 아연 · 판토텐산

광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 제조 · 1일 1회 3정

이 제품은 나이아신 15mg, 비타민 A 3mg, 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 C 200mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 아연 8.5mg, 판토텐산 500mg를 표시량으로 담은 8원료 복합 건강기능식품입니다. 각 원료의 공식 인정 기능성은 아래와 같습니다.

왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(3정) 섭취로 나이아신 15mg, 비타민 A 3mg, 비타민 B1 1.2mg, 비타민 B2 1.4mg, 비타민 C 200mg, 비타민 D 10μg, 아연 8.5mg, 판토텐산 500mg
  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미.이취가 없는 연한 자줏빛 분홍색의 장방형 제피정제 · 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • 나이아신
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 A
    • 어두운 곳에서 시각 적응을 위해 필요
    • 피부와 점막을 형성하고 기능을 유지하는데 필요
    • 상피세포의 성장과 발달에 필요
  • 비타민 B1
    • 탄수화물과 에너지 대사에 필요
  • 비타민 B2
    • 체내 에너지 생성에 필요
  • 비타민 C
    • 결합조직 형성과 기능유지에 필요
    • 철의 흡수에 필요
    • 항산화 작용을 하여 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 비타민 D
    • 칼슘과 인이 흡수되고 이용되는데 필요
    • 뼈의 형성과 유지에 필요
    • 골다공증발생 위험 감소에 도움을 줌
  • 아연
    • 정상적인 면역기능에 필요
    • 정상적인 세포분열에 필요
  • 판토텐산
    • 지방, 탄수화물, 단백질 대사와 에너지 생성에 필요

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 1회1회 3정물과 함께

표시 기준

나이아신 표시량(15mg/1650mg)의 80~150%
비타민 A 표시량(3mg/1650mg)의 80~150%
비타민 B1 표시량(1.2mg/1650mg)의 80~180%
비타민 B2 표시량(1.4mg/1650mg)의 80~180%
비타민 C 표시량(200mg/1650mg)의 80~150%
비타민 D 표시량(10μg/1650mg)의 80~180%
아연 표시량(8.5mg/1650mg)의 80~150%

대장균군 음성
유통기한 제조일로부터 24개월

이런 분께

  • 매일 나이아신 · 비타민 A · 비타민 B1 · 비타민 B2 · 비타민 C · 비타민 D · 아연 · 판토텐산 섭취를 함께 챙기고 싶은 분

Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgVitamin A 3mgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin C 200mgVitamin D 10μgZinc 8.5mgPantothenic acid 500mgOnce a day

서퍼데이, 판토비Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Zinc · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 3 tablets

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 3mg of Vitamin A, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 200mg of Vitamin C, 10μg of Vitamin D, 8.5mg of Zinc, 500mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (3 tablets): 15mg Niacin, 3mg Vitamin A, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 200mg Vitamin C, 10μg Vitamin D, 8.5mg Zinc, 500mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day3 tablets per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 1650mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (3mg / 1650mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 1650mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 1650mg), 80~180%
Vitamin C labelled (200mg / 1650mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (10μg / 1650mg), 80~180%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 1650mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (500mg / 1650mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미.이취가 없는 연한 자줏빛 분홍색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Zinc · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

This product combines 120mg of Magnesium, 7μg of Vitamin B12, 1.2mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 35mg of Vitamin C, 5μg of Vitamin D, 210mg of Calcium as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 120mg Magnesium, 7μg Vitamin B12, 1.2mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 35mg Vitamin C, 5μg Vitamin D, 210mg Calcium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)허브큐어

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Calcium
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
    • Needed for the formation of bones and teeth
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
    • Needed for normal blood clotting

Once a day2 tablets per servingWith water

대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장 제조 · 1일 1회 1정

  • 대장균군 음성 — 식약처 신고 기준 적합
  • 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연한 황갈색의 점박이를 함유한 노란 하양색의 장방형 제피정제 · 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장 제조

원료별 공식 인정 기능성

  • 비타민 B12
    • 정상적인 엽산 대사에 필요
  • 셀레늄
    • 유해산소로부터 세포를 보호하는데 필요
  • 요오드
    • 갑상선 호르몬의 합성에 필요
    • 에너지 생성에 필요
    • 신경발달에 필요

섭취방법 (공식 표기 그대로)

1일 1회1회 1정물과 함께

표시 기준

비타민 B12 표시량(2.4μg/500mg)의 80~180%
셀레늄 표시량(27.5μg/500mg)의 80~150%
요오드 표시량(150μg/500mg)의 80~150%

drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodVitamin B12 2.4μgSelenium 27.5μgIodine 150μgOnce a day

유기농 요오드Vitamin B12 · Selenium · Iodine

Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 27.5μg of Selenium, 150μg of Iodine as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 27.5μg Selenium, 150μg Iodine
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 대원헬스케어 주식회사 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Iodine
    • Needed for the synthesis of thyroid hormones
    • Needed for energy production
    • Needed for neural development

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Vitamin B12 labelled (2.4μg / 500mg), 80~180%
Selenium labelled (27.5μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Iodine labelled (150μg / 500mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 연한 황갈색의 점박이를 함유한 노란 하양색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 습기 및 열에 의해 품질에 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 실온에 보관하시고, 개봉 후에는 공기의 노출을 최대한 차단하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B12 · Selenium · Iodine together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Health Functional FoodMagnesium 315mgVitamin A 700μgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B12 2.4μgVitamin B6 1.5mgSelenium 27.5μgOnce a day

마그네슘프리미엄Magnesium · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B6 · Selenium

Made by 일양약품(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 315mg of Magnesium, 700μg of Vitamin A, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 27.5μg of Selenium as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 315mg Magnesium, 700μg Vitamin A, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 27.5μg Selenium
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 일양약품(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
